example.en: Engineering and marketing divisions worked together to ensure the successful rollout of the device.
example.zh: 工程與行銷部門通力合作，以確保該裝置成功推向市場。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 團隊合作核心詞：work together (合作)、put together (組合/組建)。

example.en: The hiring committee will carefully consider all candidate credentials before scheduling interviews.
example.zh: 招募委員會將在安排面試前仔細考慮所有候選人的資歷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 決策常用動詞，後接名詞或 V-ing：consider doing something。
roots: sider 星星 → 觀星思索

example.en: Our store guarantees the lowest price on all name-brand office supplies this season.
example.zh: 本季本店保證所有知名品牌辦公用品皆為最低價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業銷售核心字：reasonable price (合理價格)、price tag (標價籤)。

example.en: The regional subsidiary received comprehensive capital funding from its European parent company.
example.zh: 該區域子公司從其歐洲母公司獲得了全面的資金挹注。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業組織多益常考：parent company (母公司)。

example.en: The technical staff worked hard throughout the weekend to restore the crashed database server.
example.zh: 技術人員整個週末都在辛勤工作以恢復崩潰的資料庫伺服器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場工作態度：work hard (努力工作)；hard copy (紙本印刷件)。

example.en: Both contracting parties have agreed to the revised terms outlined in the merger document.
example.zh: 雙方締約當事人皆同意合併文件中列出的修訂條款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益法律商業大考點：party 指契約雙方，如 third party (第三方)、both parties (雙方)。

example.en: Our restaurant chain partners with local organic farmers to source fresh seasonal vegetables.
example.zh: 我們的連鎖餐廳與在地有機農民合作以採購新鮮的當季蔬菜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購與商務社區關係常用：local business (在地商家)、local branch (在地分行)。

example.en: Rigorous quality control inspections are conducted at every stage of the manufacturing process.
example.zh: 製造過程的每一個階段皆實施嚴格的品質管制檢驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 品管必背片語：quality control (品管/QC)、under control (在控制中)。

example.en: The courier service reported that your replacement package has already been delivered to reception.
example.zh: 快遞服務回報表示您的換貨包裹已經送達接待櫃檯。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 進度狀態確認詞，常搭配現在完成式 (has already been delivered)。

example.en: The accounting division keeps an accurate electronic record of all commercial transactions.
example.zh: 會計部門對所有商務交易皆保存有精確無誤的電子紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞 /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 記錄；名詞 /ˈrɛkərd/ 檔案紀錄：track record (過往績效紀錄)。

example.en: Hotel guests who extend their stay by two days will receive complimentary spa vouchers.
example.zh: 延長住宿兩天的飯店房客將可獲得免費水療抵用券。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 旅館住宿與狀態維持：stay at a hotel (住飯店)、stay informed (保持知悉)。

example.en: The enterprise is expanding its engineering workforce to meet growing demand for cloud services.
example.zh: 該企業正在擴大其工程人力團隊，以滿足對雲端服務日益增長的需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場最常考複合字：workforce (勞動力/全體員工)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: The express airport shuttle makes a brief passenger pickup stop outside terminal two.
example.zh: 機場快捷接駁車會在第二航廈外做短暫的旅客上車停靠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通工具停靠：bus stop (公車站)；non-stop (直達的/不間斷的)。

example.en: The hiring committee interviewed several qualified candidates for the senior accounting position.
example.zh: 招募委員會面試了數名具備資歷的應徵者以填補資深會計職缺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾複數可數名詞：several times (好幾次)、several options (好幾個選項)。

example.en: Please ensure that all overhead office lights are switched off before locking up the building.
example.zh: 在鎖門離開大樓前，請確保所有辦公室頭頂照明皆已關閉。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務轉折短語：in light of (有鑑於...)；lightweight (輕量級的)。

example.en: Our software engineers worked diligently to develop a user-friendly mobile banking application.
example.zh: 我們的軟體工程師勤奮工作，以開發出一款操作簡便的手機網銀應用程式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 研發核心動詞：develop a product (開發產品)、develop a plan (擬定計畫)。

example.en: Please remember to attach your itemized expense receipts when requesting travel reimbursement.
example.zh: 申請差旅費報銷時，請務必記得檢附逐項列記的支出收據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 叮嚀句型必備：remember to do (記得去做某事)。

example.en: The final contract negotiations took a bit longer than originally anticipated by management.
example.zh: 最終的合約談判比管理層原先預期的時間稍微久了一點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 副詞修飾片語：a bit (稍微/一點點)、bit by bit (循序漸進)。

example.en: Our new smartphone product line helped the enterprise expand its global market share.
example.zh: 我們的新智慧型手機產品線幫助企業擴大了其全球市場份額。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業金融大考點：market share (市占率)、shareholders (股東)。

example.en: The corporate expansion committee consulted an experienced real estate agency to locate new offices.
example.zh: 企業擴張委員會諮詢了一家經驗豐富的房地產經紀公司以尋找新辦公室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心考點：real estate (不動產/房地產)。

example.en: Our customer service representatives strive to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 我們的客戶服務代表力求在響鈴三聲內接聽進線電話。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室電話與客服關鍵動詞：answer the phone (接聽電話)。

example.en: Meeting participants are invited to sit around the central conference table.
example.zh: 邀請與會者圍繞中央會議桌就座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議就座用語：sit at a desk (坐在辦公桌前)、be seated (就座)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the latest sales figures during the executive briefing.
example.zh: 財務長在主管簡報會議上報告了最新的銷售數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：sales figures (銷售數字)、figure out (想出/弄明白)。

example.en: Candidates must submit a cover letter and an updated resume to be considered for the position.
example.zh: 應徵者必須提交求職信與更新的履歷表方能列入該職位的考量。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職與推薦必備：cover letter (求職信)、letter of recommendation (推薦信)。

example.en: The board of directors will decide whether to approve the international merger proposal tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天決定是否核准該項跨國合併提案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 決策核心動詞：decide to do (決定做某事)、decide on (決定選擇)。
roots: cide 切 → 切斷猶豫、決定

example.en: Fluency in a second foreign language is a definite advantage for our global marketing applicants.
example.zh: 精通第二外語對於應徵我們全球行銷職缺的求職者而言是一項顯著優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷專長必填欄位：foreign language (外語)、body language (肢體語言)。

example.en: Please write a concise and clear subject line when emailing client project updates.
example.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄送客戶專案進度時，請填寫簡潔明瞭的主旨欄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信主旨與合約條件：subject line (郵件主旨)、subject to change (可能隨時變更)。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟在下面、受支配者

example.en: Corporate business executives traveling on flights over eight hours are eligible for business class.
example.zh: 搭乘飛行時間超過八小時航班的企業高階主管有資格搭乘商務艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票艙等考點：business class (商務艙)、first class (頭等艙)。

example.en: The enterprise invests heavily in professional employee development and technical training.
example.zh: 該企業大力投資於員工的專業發展與技術培訓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 科技與人事專有名詞：research and development (研發/R&D)。

example.en: Our newly renovated flagship hotel is centrally situated in the historic section of town.
example.zh: 我們新裝修的旗艦飯店位於該城鎮歷史區的中心地帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市中心核心字：downtown (市中心)、out of town (出城/不在本地)。

example.en: The airport shuttle departs from terminal two every half hour throughout the day.
example.zh: 機場接駁車全天每半小時自第二航廈發車一班。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與財報考點：half an hour (半小時)、first half of the year (上半年)。

example.en: The executive secretary distributed the official meeting minutes to all committee members.
example.zh: 執行秘書向所有委員會成員分發了正式的會議紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：單數是「分鐘」，複數 meeting minutes 則是「會議紀錄」！

example.en: The corporate catering service provided exquisite food and beverages for the banquet.
example.zh: 企業外燴服務為晚宴提供了精緻的餐飲美食與飲料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 活動餐飲詞彙：food and beverage (餐飲服務/F&B)、food court (美食街)。

example.en: Workshop attendees will enjoy a fifteen-minute coffee break before the afternoon session begins.
example.zh: 工作坊與會者將在下午會議開始前享受十五分鐘的咖啡茶歇時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議中場休息：coffee break (茶歇)、take a break (休息一下)。

example.en: The supervisor gave clear and direct instructions on how to file travel reimbursement claims.
example.zh: 主管對於如何申報差旅費報銷提出了清楚而直接的指示。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 清晰度與物流通關：make it clear (說明清楚)、clear customs (通關)。

example.en: We look forward to exploring mutually beneficial business opportunities in the near future.
example.zh: 我們期盼在不久的將來共同探討互利共贏的商業商機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信客套結尾句：in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Invoices can be settled using either corporate credit cards or direct electronic wire transfers.
example.zh: 發票可以透過企業信用卡或直接電子電匯轉帳任一方式進行結清。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 二選一必考配對句型：either A or B (要麼A要麼B)。

example.en: The new regional warehouse facility became fully operational three months ago.
example.zh: 這座新的區域倉儲設施在三個月前已完全投入營運。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 過去式標誌時間副詞：three days ago (三天前)。

example.en: The parking garage charges four dollars per hour during standard business daytime hours.
example.zh: 該停車場在一般日間營業時段每小時收費四美元。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 計算單位與依據：per hour (每小時)、as per your request (依照您的要求)。

example.en: Despite severe economic market fluctuations, our net operating margins remained strong.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的經濟市場波動，我們的營業淨利率依然維持強勁。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 狀態維持動詞：remain competitive (保持競爭力)、remain seated (請保持就坐)。

example.en: Ensuring workplace physical safety remains the top priority of factory plant management.
example.zh: 確保工作場所的人身安全始終是工廠廠房管理層的首要之務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 第一優先與高階管理：top priority (最高優先)、top management (高層管理)。

example.en: Our lightweight laptop was ranked among the top three models in terms of battery efficiency.
example.zh: 我們的輕量筆記型電腦在電池續航力效能方面名列前三名之列。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法三者以上群體比較：among + 複數名詞 (在...之中)。

example.en: The architectural firm worked diligently to win the commercial design bid for the airport.
example.zh: 該建築事務所勤奮耕耘以贏得機場的商業設計招標標案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 得標與獲獎常用：win a contract (贏得合約)、win an award (獲獎)。

example.en: The corporate brochure will be printed in full color on premium recycled glossy paper.
example.zh: 企業簡介手冊將在高級環保回收銅版紙上進行全彩印刷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 印刷與商品規格常用片語：in full color (全彩印刷)。

example.en: The office relocation project will involve close coordination between all department heads.
example.zh: 辦公室搬遷專案將涉及所有部門主管之間的密切協調。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 專案範疇與參與度動詞：be involved in (參與其中)。

example.en: You can reach our technical support desk by dialing the toll-free customer hotline.
example.zh: 您可以透過撥打免付費客戶專線聯絡到我們的技術支援台。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 通訊聯絡與達成協議：reach someone by phone (以電話聯絡某人)、reach an agreement (達成協議)。

example.en: Our digital marketing team launched an advertising campaign across multiple social media platforms.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷團隊在多個社群媒體平台上推出了一場廣告宣傳活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 數位行銷極高頻詞：social media (社群媒體)、social event (社交聚會)。

example.en: Newly recruited software developers will undergo a mandatory three-month probationary period.
example.zh: 新進軟體開發人員將接受為期三個月的強制性試用期。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 試用期與保固期名詞：probationary period (試用期)、warranty period (保固期)。

example.en: Our courier logistics network operates distribution fulfillment centers across the country.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流網路在全國各地營運多座配送履約中心。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 遍及全球與全國常見介系詞：across the country / across the globe。

example.en: Industrial cooling fans must be serviced periodically to maintain optimal warehouse airflow.
example.zh: 工業冷卻排風扇必須定期保養維護，以維持倉儲廠房內最佳的空氣對流。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 廠區排熱設備：cooling fan (冷卻散熱風扇)、exhaust fan (抽風機)。

example.en: Corporate executive suites include a fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances.
example.zh: 企業高級主管套房內配置了一間設備齊全且附有現代化家電的簡易廚房。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務套房設施：fully equipped kitchen (設備齊全的廚房)、kitchen appliances。

example.en: Facilities maintenance inspections are conducted twice a year to ensure safety compliance.
example.zh: 總務廠房維護檢查每年實施兩次，以確保完全符合安全標準規範。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 頻率排程詞彙：twice a year (一年兩次)、twice as much (兩倍之多)。

example.en: Bringing in an external consultant provides a fresh perspective on corporate restructuring.
example.zh: 聘請外部管理顧問能為企業組織重組帶來全新且跳脫框架的嶄新視角。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：fresh perspective (嶄新視角) 或 fresh food (生鮮食物)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the unexpected shipping delay caused by harsh winter blizzards.
example.zh: 對於嚴酷冬季暴風雪所造成的意外出貨延誤，我們由衷深表歉意。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益機場與出貨最高頻考點：flight delay (班機延誤)、shipping delay (運送延誤)。

example.en: All factory production employees must attend the mandatory annual workplace safety seminar.
example.zh: 所有工廠產線員工均必須參加每年一次的強制性職場工安研習營。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工安規定必備：safety regulations (安全法規)、safety equipment (防護安全裝備)。

example.en: The chief systems engineer presented innovative architectural plans for the data center.
example.zh: 首席系統工程師提出了針對雲端數據中心的創新架構規劃設計圖。

reviewWords.mnemonic: engine (引擎、機器) + -eer (從業專業人士) ＝ 工程師 (software engineer)。

example.en: The hotel concierge provided rooms situated along a quiet corridor overlooking the courtyard.
example.zh: 飯店禮賓部為房客安排了位於安靜走廊且俯瞰中庭花園的靜謐客房。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 住宿與辦公環境需求：quiet room (安靜客房)、quiet area (靜音區)。

example.en: Freight shipping costs include comprehensive maritime cargo loss and damage insurance.
example.zh: 貨運運費內已涵蓋了全面的海運貨物遺失及損害賠償保險保障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: in- (進入) + sure (確定、安全) + -ance ＝ 確保萬全的保障機制 ＝ 保險。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness clinic is staffed by certified occupational health nurses.
example.zh: 企業員工健康照護中心由具備執照的專業職業衛生護理師駐診服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工健康中心駐點：occupational nurse (職業衛生護理師)。

example.en: The training seminar facilitator will divide attendees into small collaborative workshop groups.
example.zh: 研討培訓引導講師將把與會者分成數個協同合作的工作坊討論小組。

reviewWords.mnemonic: di- (分開) + vid (分開、看) ＝ 劃分 (divide into)。

example.en: The length of each keynote presentation will be strictly limited to twenty-five minutes.
example.zh: 每場主題演講的長度時間將被嚴格限制在二十五分鐘以內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: long (長的) 的名詞形式；成語 at length (詳細地、長篇大論)。

example.en: Safety regulators launched an investigation into the electrical equipment factory failure.
example.zh: 工安監理主管機關針對該工廠電氣設備故障意外展開了正式調查。

reviewWords.mnemonic: in- (進入) + vestig (足跡、痕跡) + -ation ＝ 順著痕跡追查到底 ＝ 調查。

example.en: The logistics carrier sent a tracking notification when the package left the warehouse.
example.zh: 當包裹離開物流倉儲發貨中心時，貨運物流業者發送了物流追蹤通知。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：寄送包裹 (parcel/package) 或薪酬福利套裝 (compensation package)。

example.en: Total expenditures for the branch office renovation are estimated somewhere around eighty thousand dollars.
example.zh: 分行辦公室重新整修的總預算支出估計大約在八萬美元上下。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 數額約計片語：somewhere around / between (大約在...左右)。

example.en: The retail chain plans to expand its presence by opening twenty new franchise outlets.
example.zh: 該連鎖零售集團計劃透過開設二十家全新加盟門市來拓展其市場版圖。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + pand (展開) ＝ 向外鋪展開來 ＝ 業務擴張 (expand business/presence)。

example.en: The board resolved to commit substantial financial resources to clean energy development.
example.zh: 董事會決議投入巨額資金財務資源以支持潔淨能源的技術研發。

reviewWords.mnemonic: com- (共同) + mit (送出、託付) ＝ 全力託付承諾 ＝ commit to (致力於)。

example.en: It is obvious that investing in employee training yields superior long-term productivity.
example.zh: 顯而易見的是，投資於員工培訓進修能帶來卓越亮眼的長期生產力回報。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ob- (在前方) + vi (道路) + -ous ＝ 擺在路正前方的 ＝ 顯而易見的。

example.en: Retail sales revenue jumped by twenty percent following the launch of the promotional campaign.
example.zh: 促銷活動正式推行發表之後，零售銷售營收暴漲攀升了百分之二十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財經圖表常見動詞：sales jumped (銷售跳躍式激增)。

meaning: 秘密武器(行銷/競爭手段)

example.en: Advanced data analytics is our firm's most potent competitive weapon in digital marketing.
example.zh: 先進的巨量數據分析是我們公司在數位行銷競爭中最有力的利器秘密武器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭引申義：competitive weapon (市場競爭利器)。

example.en: Our new cloud-based software subscription remains relatively inexpensive compared to rivals.
example.zh: 與同業競爭對手相較，我們這套新型雲端軟體訂閱方案依然維持相對便宜實惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: relative (相對的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 相較之下 (relatively inexpensive)。

example.en: Our downtown corporate convention hotel will host the upcoming international trade summit.
example.zh: 我們位於市中心的商務會議大飯店將主辦即將到來的國際貿易高峰會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務會展必備核心動詞：host an event / conference (主辦活動/大會)。

example.en: The alpine ski resort experiences its peak tourism booking occupancy during the winter season.
example.zh: 這間高山滑雪度假村在冬季期間迎來了其全年度旅遊預訂住房率的最高峰。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 排程與季報考點：winter recess (寒假休假)、winter season (冬季旅遊季)。

example.en: Our international consulting headquarters is strategically situated in the central financial district.
example.zh: 我們的跨國管理顧問總部策略性地座落於市中心的中央金融商務特區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商辦地段描述核心：financial district (金融特區)、business district (商務特區)。
roots: string- / strict- 拉緊、限制區域

example.en: Our expanded product portfolio appeals to a broad range of international retail customers.
example.zh: 我們擴大推出的產品系列組合能吸引廣泛多元的國際零售消費者群體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業極常見搭配：broad range of (廣泛的...)、broad appeal (廣泛的吸引力)。

example.en: Corporate logistics delivery fleet vehicles undergo mandatory monthly tire pressure inspections.
example.zh: 企業物流運送車隊的所有車輛均必須接受每月定期的強制性胎壓安全檢驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 車隊保養與物流必備：tire pressure (胎壓)、spare tire (備胎)。

example.en: Our fashion retail brand will unveil its new spring clothing collection at next week's expo.
example.zh: 我們的時尚服飾品牌將在下週的博覽會上正式發表其全新春季服裝系列產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 季節促銷常見：spring collection (春季系列)、spring break (春假特惠)。

example.en: The corporate employee retreat successfully fostered a cooperative team spirit among departments.
example.zh: 這場企業員工共識營成功促進了各部門之間通力合作的團隊合作精神。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場考核特質：team spirit (團隊精神)；in the spirit of (秉持著...的宗旨精神)。

example.en: A complimentary buffet lunch will be provided to all registered trade conference attendees.
example.zh: 所有完成大會報到的商務代表均將獲招待享用免費的精緻自助午餐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議日程表必見項目：lunch break (午餐休息)、business lunch (商務午餐)。

example.en: Actual project production expenditures closely matched our initial preliminary quarterly budget.
example.zh: 專案實際的生產支出花費與我們原先初步編列的季度預算十分高度吻合。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務對比極高頻：actual vs projected (實際數值對照預估數值)。

example.en: Our international recruitment drive attracted an exceptionally talented applicant pool.
example.zh: 我們的跨國人才招募活動吸引了素質極其優異頂尖的龐大求職人才庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：applicant pool / talent pool (應徵人才庫) 或 carpool (共乘制度)。

example.en: Streaming platforms are engaged in a fierce market battle for exclusive digital sports rights.
example.zh: 各大線上影音串流平台正展開激烈的市場商戰，爭奪體育賽事的獨家數位轉播權。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭比喻：legal battle (訴訟大戰)、market battle (市佔率爭奪戰)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you again for your patience.
example.zh: 我們對造成的不便深表歉意，並再次感謝您的耐心配合。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服道歉信結尾高頻句：Thank you once again (再次感謝您)。

example.en: What kind of warranty coverage is provided with the commercial laser printer?
example.zh: 這款商用雷射印表機隨附何種保固保障？

reviewWords.mnemonic: 詢問規格常用：what kind of (哪一種)；形容詞 kind assistance (親切協助)。

example.en: Please keep your original purchase receipts for at least thirty days to facilitate warranty claims.
example.zh: 請妥善保留原始購買收據至少三十天，以便辦理保固理賠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務溝通片語：keep in mind (牢記在心)、keep updated (隨時保持最新資訊)。

example.en: We were very pleased to hear that your company was awarded the regional trade contract.
example.zh: 我們非常高興得知貴公司榮獲該區域貿易合約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務社交致賀常客：hear from someone (收到某人來信/消息)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters upgraded its internal payroll system to automate tax calculations.
example.zh: 企業總部升級了內部薪資核算系統，以實現稅額自動計算。

reviewWords.mnemonic: IT與辦公科技核心詞：computer system (電腦系統)、operating system (作業系統)。

example.en: Safety inspectors conduct thorough maintenance checks on factory elevators every six months.
example.zh: 安全檢查員每六個月對工廠電梯進行一次全面的維護檢查。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 頻率周期考點：every year (每年)、every six months (每六個月)。

example.en: The seminar presenter will answer audience questions during the final twenty minutes of the session.
example.zh: 研討會主講人將在會議最後二十分鐘回答現場觀眾的提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議問答標準詞：question and answer (Q&A 問答環節)。

example.en: Employees may purchase discounted meals in the company cafeteria during lunch hours.
example.zh: 員工可以在午休時間於公司員工餐廳購買優惠餐點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益介系詞大考點：during 後接表示期間的名詞 (如 during the meeting)。

example.en: Ms. Jenkins comes highly recommended by several prestigious engineering executive directors.
example.zh: 詹金斯女士獲得數位知名工程主管的一致高度推薦。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻副詞搭配：highly recommended (高度推薦)、highly qualified (條件極佳)。

example.en: Building long-term client trust is essential for sustainable corporate wealth advisory services.
example.zh: 建立長期的客戶信賴對於永續經營企業財富顧問服務至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業信用基礎：mutual trust (互信)、earn trust (贏得信賴)。

example.en: Guests expressed that they had a truly wonderful dining experience at the resort restaurant.
example.zh: 賓客們表示在度假村餐廳享受到了一次極為美妙出色的用餐體驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: wonder (驚嘆) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 令人極其滿意讚嘆的。

example.en: Our logistics courier offers a convenient flat rate shipping fee for standard parcel boxes.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流為標準包裹紙箱提供便捷的單一固定運費。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業財經核心搭配：flat rate (單一費率)、sales remained flat (營收持平未增減)。

example.en: Meeting the strict delivery deadline is absolutely critical to retaining this corporate client.
example.zh: 嚴格達成交貨期限對於留住這家企業重要客戶而言是絕對關鍵的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ab- (離) + solut (鬆開、解開) ＝ 完全不受拘束 ＝ 絕對地 (absolutely necessary)。

example.en: Careful working capital management ensures steady cash flow during seasonal sales slowdowns.
example.zh: 審慎的營運資金管理確保了在淡季銷售放緩期間仍維持穩定的現金流。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務極高頻：cash flow (現金流)；workflow (工作流程)。

example.en: Our recruitment team booked an exhibition booth at the metropolitan job fair next month.
example.zh: 我們的招募團隊在下個月的都會就業博覽會上預訂了展覽攤位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞常考商展：job fair (就業博覽會)、trade fair (貿易展)；形容詞指公平 (fair share)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested additional funding resources to hire temporary contract workers.
example.zh: 專案主管申請了額外的預算資源以聘請臨時約聘人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: add (增加) + -tion (名詞) + -al ＝ 附加的 (additional charge / info)。

example.en: The supermarket chain procures fresh organic vegetables directly from certified local farms.
example.zh: 該連鎖超市直接自在地獲得認證的有機農場採購新鮮生鮮蔬菜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購食品原物料常用：organic farm (有機農場)、farm-to-table (產地直送餐桌)。

example.en: The fashion retailer will launch its new autumn clothing collection in flagship stores.
example.zh: 該時尚零售商將在旗艦門市發表其全新的秋季服裝系列產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：new collection (新系列商品) 或 debt collection (催討應收帳款)。

example.en: Hotel guests may hang the 'Do Not Disturb' card outside on their room door handle.
example.zh: 飯店房客可將「請勿打擾」標示卡懸掛在房門把手外側。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客房常考：hang a sign (掛上標示牌)；片語 hang up (掛斷電話)。

example.en: Customer service representatives responded quickly to resolve negative online reviews.
example.zh: 客服專員迅速做出回應以處理並解決網路上的負面評價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: neg- (否定、拒絕) + -ive ＝ 負面的 (negative feedback / review)。

example.en: The marketing department divided our consumer products into distinct premium pricing bands.
example.zh: 行銷部門將我們的消費性產品劃分入不同的優質價格區間帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞指樂團或「價格區間帶 (price band) / 頻寬 (broadband)」。

example.en: We evaluated the relative cost advantages of local manufacturing versus offshore outsourcing.
example.zh: 我們評估了在地製造與海外委外代工兩者之間的相對成本優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + lat (帶來) + -ive ＝ 相互帶入比較的 ＝ 相對的。

example.en: Prospective overseas investors were taken on a comprehensive guided tour of the factory plant.
example.zh: 海外潛在投資人獲邀參加了一場全方位的工廠廠區專人導覽參訪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 參訪行程常見：guided tour (專人導覽)、factory tour (廠房巡視參觀)。

example.en: Management explored alternative shipping suppliers to mitigate ongoing maritime freight delays.
example.zh: 管理階層評估了替代的航運供應商以緩解持續發生的海運延誤危機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: alter (其他、改變) + -ative ＝ 其他可選的路徑 ＝ 替代方案。

example.en: The corporate technology team deployed enterprise accounting software across all branches.
example.zh: 企業資訊科技團隊在所有分行全面佈署了企業資源會計軟體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: soft (軟) + ware (器具製品) ＝ 電腦軟體（注意不可數名詞）。

example.en: Every technician working on the electronic assembly line is issued a pair of anti-static gloves.
example.zh: 每位在電子組裝產線工作的技術員皆獲發一雙防靜電手套。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 量詞常用：a pair of (一雙/一副)；pair up with (與...搭配合作)。

example.en: The automated distribution center can ship confirmed online retail orders within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 該自動化物流中心能在二十四小時內將確認的線上零售訂單完成出貨。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流核心動詞：ship an order (訂單出貨)；名詞 shipment (裝運貨物)。

example.en: A positive customer-first attitude is the most valued quality in our hospitality staff.
example.zh: 積極主動的顧客至上心態是我們飯店款待人員中最受看重的特質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場考核重點：positive attitude (正向態度)、attitude towards work。

example.en: Budget airlines offer cheap domestic fares by charging extra for checked baggage.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司透過對托運行李額外收費來提供極為便宜的國內線機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 價格實惠 (cheap airfare)；在商務文案中常以 affordable 代替以避免廉價感。

example.en: Our digital sales revenue doubled following the nationwide promotional discount campaign.
example.zh: 在全國性促銷折扣活動推行之後，我們的數位銷售營收翻倍成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 業績翻倍 (revenue doubled)；飯店 double room (雙人客房)。

example.en: The final flight leg of our business journey departs from Frankfurt at eight tonight.
example.zh: 我們出差行程的最後一段航程預定於今晚八點自法蘭克福起飛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益旅行航段特殊義：the first/last leg of the journey (旅程的第一/最後一段)。

example.en: All factory production contractors must strictly observe national environmental safety regulations.
example.zh: 所有工廠生產承包商均必須嚴格遵守國家環境保護安全法規。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ob- (朝向) + serv (守護、注意) ＝ 留心注意 ＝ 觀察或嚴格遵守規章。

example.en: Please draft a concise summary sentence to introduce the main points of the proposal.
example.zh: 請撰寫一句簡明扼要的摘要句，以引言說明企劃案的核心要點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sent- (感覺、判斷) ＝ 表達完整判斷意義的話 ＝ 句子或司法判決。

example.en: Please print fifty copies of the executive conference agenda for our board members.
example.zh: 請為董事會成員列印五十份主管會議議程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室硬體：laser printer (雷射印表機)、fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: The project development team will present a quarterly progress report to senior stakeholders.
example.zh: 專案開發團隊將向資深專案利害關係人提交季度進度報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + gress (行走) ＝ 向前邁進 ＝ 進度、進展 (progress report)。

example.en: Transparent accounting audits reveal the underlying financial truth of company operations.
example.zh: 透明公開的會計審計能如實揭露公司日常營運背後的真實財務現況。

reviewWords.mnemonic: true (真實的) + -th (抽象名詞尾) ＝ 真理、事實真相。

example.en: Nobody was permitted inside the server room without displaying a verified authorization badge.
example.zh: 未出示經核實的授權識別證者，任何人皆不得進入伺服器主機室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: no + body (人) ＝ 沒有任何人。

example.en: Quality control inspectors will thoroughly examine every electronic circuit component for manufacturing defects.
example.zh: 品管檢驗人員將澈底檢查每個電子電路元件是否存在製造缺陷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + ag- (秤量、衡量) ＝ 嚴格檢測 ＝ 檢查、檢視。

example.en: Due to company restructuring, the corporate management had to lay off sixty workers.
example.zh: 由於公司組織重整，企業管理層不得不裁減解僱六十名員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益人資必考片語：lay off (裁員解僱)；lay off workers (裁撤勞工)。

example.en: Upgrading automated processing equipment will greatly improve order fulfillment turnaround speed.
example.zh: 升級自動化處理設備將大幅提升訂單履行完成的周轉處理速度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務效率核心詞：high speed (高速)、speed up (加速)。

example.en: The courier scheduled the package delivery between two and four in the afternoon.
example.zh: 快遞人員已將包裹配送時段排定在下午兩點到四點之間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與地點範圍經典介系詞：between A and B (在A與B之間)。

example.en: Please feel free to ask our customer service representative if you need any assistance.
example.zh: 如果您需要任何協助，請隨時向我們的客服專員詢問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信與服務極高頻客氣片語：feel free to (請隨時/別客氣)。

example.en: The original quote was deemed too high, so the purchasing agent negotiated for a discount.
example.zh: 最初的報價被認為過高，因此採購專員進行了議價以爭取折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務談判表示超出預算常用 too high / too expensive；放句尾表「也」。

example.en: The accounting division is still waiting for the client to confirm invoice details.
example.zh: 會計部門仍在等待客戶確認發票詳細資訊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 表示進度尚在處理中：still pending (仍在審核中/尚未定案)。

example.en: Our support technicians are trained to identify and solve technical problems quickly.
example.zh: 我們的支援技術人員受過專業訓練，能夠迅速發現並解決技術問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服與維修的核心搭配：solve a problem (解決問題)、technical problem (技術故障)。

example.en: The senior research associate was asked to write a comprehensive report on market trends.
example.zh: 資深研究專員受命撰寫一份關於市場趨勢的綜合報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場公文必備動作：write a report (寫報告)、write a proposal (寫提案)。

example.en: All orders placed prior to eleven in the morning are processed on the same day.
example.zh: 所有在上午十一點前下達的訂單都會在同一天處理完畢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電商與出貨關鍵詞：the same day (同一天)；the same as (與...相同)。

example.en: Visitors are requested to park their cars in the designated parking lot adjacent to the hall.
example.zh: 訪客請將車輛停放在大廳旁的專用停車場內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場場景考點：parking lot (停車場)；a lot of (許多)。
